Personal Assistant to the CEO Job at Prixair Group




        
    

        
        Prixair Group is a dynamic and diversified company committed to excellence across various industries, including hospitality, beauty, events, logistics, media, and lifestyle services. With a passion for delivering world-class experiences, Prixair has built a strong reputation for quality, professionalism, and innovation.
     

            
    



Driven by a customer-first philosophy, Prixair Group continuously sets industry benchmarks through exceptional service delivery, operational efficiency, and a dedicated workforce. Our diverse portfolio of brands works seamlessly together to provide top-tier solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals and organizations. From premium spa treatments to event planning, media production, transport, and hotel management, Prixair Group is dedicated to creating value and inspiring trust across every touchpoint.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Personal Assistant to the CEO

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Responsibilities


	Manage the CEO’s calendar, appointments, meetings, and daily schedule.
	Coordinate internal and external meetings, including preparing agendas, materials, and meeting rooms.
	Manage correspondence, emails, phone calls, and other communications on behalf of the CEO when required.
	Prepare, proofread, and format reports, presentations, letters, memos, and other business documents.
	Take accurate meeting notes, track action points, and follow up on outstanding tasks.
	Arrange domestic and international travel, including flights, accommodation, transportation, itineraries, and visas where applicable.
	Organise business and personal appointments and ensure the CEO is fully prepared for engagements.
	Maintain an organised filing system for confidential documents and records.
	Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion.
	Act as a liaison between the CEO, senior management, clients, partners, and other stakeholders.
	Monitor deadlines and priorities, ensuring important matters receive timely attention.
	Conduct research and prepare briefing notes or summaries to support the CEO’s decision-making.
	Assist with planning and coordinating corporate events, meetings, conferences, and other engagements.
	Support the CEO with personal administrative tasks where required.
	Anticipate the CEO’s needs and proactively resolve administrative and logistical issues.
	Perform other duties and special projects as assigned by the CEO.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

title: Job Openings at Shawsand Medical Centre
content:
Shawsand Medical Centre is a world-class medical facility located in Port Harcourt. We have different medical equipment that aids us in treating our patients and various surgical procedures. Our staff are highly trained and dedicated towards their work. We are computerized and this makes the jobeasier. It also ensures continuity. We at Shawsand Medical Centre have chosen to adopt this model of patient care in Nigeria in our areas of focus, utilizing the state-of-the-artequipment in our facility and local, national, and international expertise that is available to provide solutions to our patients' problems.

Employmentmarket analysis

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:
     

            
    



1.) Head, Medical Laboratory

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	The Head of Medical Laboratory will be responsible for the overall supervision, coordination, and effective management of the hospital’s laboratory operations.
	The successful candidate will ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and reliable laboratory services while maintaining professional standards, quality control, proper documentation, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
	The role requires a qualified and experienced Medical Laboratory Scientist with strong leadership, administrative, and organizational abilities.


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee the day-to-day operations of the medical laboratory.
	Supervise, coordinate, and manage laboratory staff and workflow.
	Ensure accurate, timely, and reliable processing and reporting of laboratory results.
	Establish and maintain effective laboratory quality control and quality assurance procedures.
	Ensure proper handling, identification, storage, and processing of patient samples.
	Monitor laboratory equipment, reagents, consumables, and inventory levels.
	Ensure proper documentation, record-keeping, and maintenance of laboratory registers.
	Develop and implement laboratory procedures, work instructions, and operational standards.
	Ensure compliance with applicable medical laboratory, health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
	Monitor staff performance, attendance, discipline, and professional development.
	Prepare laboratory reports and provide operational updates to hospital management.
	Coordinate equipment maintenance, calibration, and timely reporting of faults.
	Ensure proper infection prevention and control practices within the laboratory.
	Manage laboratory-related complaints and support continuous improvement initiatives.
	Liaise with hospital management, medical staff, and other departments to ensure effective service delivery.
	Maintain confidentiality of patient information and laboratory records.
	Perform other duties as may be assigned by hospital management.


Education and Professional Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Medical Laboratory Science (BMLS) or an equivalent recognized qualification.
	Must be registered with the Medical Laboratory Science Council of Nigeria (MLSCN).
	Possession of a valid practicing licence.
	Relevant professional certifications or postgraduate qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:


	Minimum of 5 years of relevant post-qualification experience in a medical laboratory setting.
	Proven experience in laboratory supervision, coordination, or management.
	Experience in quality control, laboratory documentation, and staff supervision.
	Experience working in a hospital or diagnostic laboratory environment.
	Administrative or management experience will be an added advantage.
	Experience in equipment management, inventory control, and laboratory reporting is desirable.


Required Skills and Competencies:


	Strong leadership and supervisory skills.
	Excellent organizational and administrative abilities.
	Good knowledge of medical laboratory operations and procedures.
	Strong understanding of laboratory quality control and quality assurance.
	Good analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to supervise staff and manage laboratory workflow effectively.
	Good documentation and report-writing skills.
	Ability to work independently and demonstrate professional judgment.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and laboratory information systems will be an advantage.
	Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
	Ability to maintain confidentiality and professional ethics.


Other Requirements:


	Preferably 40 years and above.
	Applicants residing in Obigbo/Oyigbo or nearby areas will have an advantage.
	Must demonstrate professionalism, integrity, and a strong sense of responsibility.
	Must be physically and mentally capable of performing the duties of the role.
	Must be willing to comply with hospital policies, procedures, and operational standards.
	Must be able to work effectively with doctors, nurses, laboratory staff, management, and other hospital personnel.
	Must be willing to provide relevant professional credentials and references when required.


Remuneration and Benefits


	Monthly Salary: N200,000 – N350,000, negotiable based on experience and qualifications.
	Salary will be determined based on the candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, leadership ability, and overall suitability for the role.
	Other benefits may be discussed during the interview and will be subject to hospital policy.


Application Closing Date: 30th November, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated application Letter, Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), and Copies of relevant professional qualifications and practising licence, where applicable to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

 

 

2.) Housekeeper

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a hardworking, reliable, and responsible Housekeeper to join its team.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain cleanliness and hygiene throughout the hospital premises.
	Clean and disinfect patient rooms, offices, corridors, washrooms, and other designated areas.
	Properly handle and dispose of waste in accordance with hospital hygiene and safety procedures.
	Ensure cleaning supplies and equipment are properly used and maintained.
	Report maintenance issues, spills, damaged equipment, or other hazards promptly.
	Maintain a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for patients, visitors, and staff.
	Perform other housekeeping duties as assigned by management.


Requirements


	Minimum qualification: School Certificate (SSCE/WAEC/NECO or equivalent).
	Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience in cleaning homes, offices, hospitals, or similar environments.
	Previous experience working in a hospital or healthcare facility will be an added advantage.
	Good understanding of hygiene, cleanliness, and sanitation standards.
	Ability to work responsibly, efficiently, and with minimal supervision.
	Good communication and interpersonal skills.
	Must be hardworking, trustworthy, punctual, and attentive to detail.


Application Closing Date: 14th December, 2026. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using "Housekeeper Position" as the subject of the mail.

Note: For further enquiries, please call or WhatsApp: 08052097250.

 

 

3.) Staff Nurse / Midwife

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Registered Nurse / Midwife to join its healthcare team.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide comprehensive nursing and midwifery care to patients.
	Assist with antenatal, delivery, and postnatal services.
	Monitor patients' conditions and promptly report changes or concerns.
	Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records.
	Administer medications and treatments in accordance with prescribed procedures.
	Ensure compliance with clinical, infection-control, and patient-safety standards.
	Support doctors and other healthcare professionals in patient management.
	Provide health education and appropriate counselling to patients and families.
	Participate in emergency care and other clinical duties as required.


Requirements


	Must be a Registered Nurse and Midwife with a valid practising licence.
	Minimum of 10 years of post-qualification work experience.
	BLS and ACLS certifications are mandatory.
	Additional diploma or professional certifications such as Family Planning, Paediatric Nursing, Theatre Nursing, or other relevant nursing specialties will be an added advantage.
	Strong clinical, patient-care, communication, and interpersonal skills.
	Ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary healthcare team.
	Demonstrated ability to work independently and maintain high professional and ethical standards.


Salary
N50,000 - N150,000 / month. 

Application Closing Date: 14th October, 2026. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their updated CV to: [email protected] using "Nurse / Midwife Position" as the subject of the mail.

Note: For further enquiries, please call or WhatsApp: 08052097250.
